theorem_title: Exact next surviving coefficient of the actual polynomial shift difference
formal_statement:
theorem ZetaNine.CoefficientMapShiftDegree.actual_shift_difference_coefficient (n : ℕ) (H : ℚ[X]) (hH : H ≠ 0) :
    (shiftDifference n H).coeff (H.natDegree + 10) =
      (7 * (n : ℚ) - 2 - (H.natDegree : ℚ)) * H.leadingCoeff:= by sorry
natural_language_statement: For every natural $n$ and nonzero rational polynomial $H$ of natural degree $d$, the coefficient of $X^{d+10}$ in the actual $D_n(H)$ equals $(7n-2-d)\operatorname{LC}(H)$. This identity needs only $H\ne0$; no positivity, parity, degree-gap, monicity or preassigned operator relation is assumed. The degree-$d+11$ terms cancel in the actual polynomial calculation.
